skills.name: use-nano-knowledge
skills.description: Use the op project's DJI Osmo Nano knowledge and audience reasoning for product questions, potential audiences, usage motives, psychological expression analysis and consumer-comment training. Trigger on Nano能力库, Nano产品与人群能力库, Nano使用人群, 使用心理 or 心理表达 in Nano context. Keep official facts, editorial hypotheses and fictional training separate; route actual comments through the shared writer.
